Coachwith us.

SOHO Fit is South Tampa’s leading private training studio for busy professionals, parents and high achievers. We look for high-level fitness professionals who prioritize client results and want a serious, lasting career.

Work with purpose

Coach in a premium environment with systems, support and structure, so you can focus on results.

Growth & income

Competitive, performance-based pay, with top trainers earning six figures, and a brand that attracts new clients.

Support

A growth-focused team culture that helps you stay sharp, share ideas and keep developing your craft.

Award-winning

Recognized as South Tampa’s best three years running, with a reputation for professionalism and results.

Apply

Send your resume and a few lines about you. If it looks like a fit, we’ll set up a quick intro call to walk through the role and next steps.
